scope: Warm decoder-only timing; unchanged encoder latents. INT8 matrix operands, FP32 nonlinear operations/output. FP16 is excluded.

timing_protocol.strict_fp32_gate: atol1e-5,rtol1e-4 vs saved FP32 and stock; unchanged
timing_protocol.approximate_gate: No FP32 parity assertion. Finite waveform, shape, unchanged input, exact repeat/future invariance and short/long boundary checks required. Perceptual loss reported separately.
timing_protocol.activation_scaling: Per-time column over channels only. No future-time calibration.

timing_bootstrap.unit: Timing utterance; retain its five-trial mean and native output duration
timing_bootstrap.scope: Descriptive uncertainty across these ten timing utterances, not a population-wide performance guarantee

host_timing_delta.scope: Whole-VM /proc/stat counters around timing, outside inference timers
